title: Dremio Software Authentication
description: Authentication configuration for self-hosted Dremio Software using username and password. Dremio Software is deployed on-premises or in your own cloud infrastructure.

hostPort.title: Host and Port
hostPort.description: URL to your self-hosted Dremio Software instance, including protocol and port (e.g., http://localhost:9047 or https://dremio.example.com:9047).

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for authenticating with Dremio Software. This user should have appropriate permissions to access metadata.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for the Dremio Software user account.

verifySSL.title: Verify SSL
verifySSL.description: How the certificate of the Dremio server is checked when Host and Port is an https URL. 'no-ssl' checks it against the trusted authorities of the system, 'ignore' does not check it (self-signed certificate), 'validate' checks it against the CA Certificate of the SSL Config.

sslConfig.title: SSL Config
sslConfig.description: The CA certificate that signed the certificate of the Dremio server. Used when Verify SSL is 'validate'.

oneOf.title: Validate SSL Client Config
oneOf.description: OpenMetadata Client configured to validate SSL certificates.

caCertificate.title: CA Certificate
caCertificate.description: The CA certificate used for SSL validation.

sslCertificate.title: SSL Certificate
sslCertificate.description: The SSL certificate used for client authentication.

sslKey.title: SSL Key
sslKey.description: The private key associated with the SSL certificate.
